Create a career you love​

Exposebox was founded by a group of tech innovators with expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, and text mining. In 2019 Exposebox became a part of Market Group, an international group of companies with portfolios in the ad-tech and e-commerce spaces. 

Who we are

We’re in an exciting phase of challenging the digital marketing landscape. Help us drive meaningful innovation in digital marketing.

Open positions ​

Product manager

Requirements

A hands-on Senior Product Manager with at least 4 years of experience – in the online marketing industry (SaaS/eCommerce). A person who can motivate a team, ensuring every team member performs to the highest standards and grows professionally. It would be best to have top-notch product management abilities, including roadmap building, wireframing, strategy definition, and timely delivery.

You should

It would be best to have excellent managerial skills and a high level of comfort working in an agile, hands-on, innovative environment. You’re comfortable leading and managing a team of product managers and can grow the team as the need arises, ensuring the product managers are “top-level.” 

You will be responsible for

  • Hands-on ownership of all products’ quality and delivery.
  • Lead the product design and positioning in the market.  
  • Be a part of the management team, shaping the product’s strategy and roadmap.
  • Grow the team as the need arises, ensuring top-level product managers.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, marketing and professional services, and other business units.
  • Own and execute projects independently and work as part of a team.

Data scientist
About the role

You’ll be in charge of cutting-edge algorithmic solutions to turn collections of undecipherable data points into concrete, decision-driven pathways for responsibly turning data into revenue.
We work with massive data streams to create tools and abilities like DMP, RTB, LTV, recommendation engines, clustering, classification, and more.

You will be responsible for
  • Apply your expertise in statistics, data analysis, and machine learning to develop data-automated systems and algorithms to improve performance for online retail businesses.
  • Create predictive user-behavior models, recommendation and ranking systems, anomaly detection mechanisms, real-time segmentation streams and more, by converting massive, noisy data sets into significant outputs.
  • Dig into the latest big data technologies to develop distributed, high-throughput, real-time products.
  • Make independent decisions on how to solve specific problems based on raw datasets.
  • Stay connected with the business domains and develop predictive models to support business decisions.
  • Our ideal candidate is results-focused, able to work in a multi-disciplinary team in short development cycles, solid quantitative background, and good business understanding.
Requirements
  • 3+ years of experience in design, coding, and optimizing predictive and clustering models. 
  • Experience with the Ad-tech or E-commerce world is an advantage.
  • 3+ years of experience writing production Python code, including experience with Numpy, Scipy, NLTK, Pandas, PIL
  • Scala, R, and Octave are an advantage.
  • 2+ years of experience using distributed ecosystems.
  • Experience with Hadoop, Kafka, and Hbase is an advantage.
  • 2+ years of experience writing in Spark
  • RDD expertise, Spark Streaming, and Pyspark are an advantage.
  • Knowledge of relational databases and non-relational databases and query languages (SQL).
  • Working experience with Linux OS (CentOS/Ubuntu).
  • Strong background in statistics.
  • Prior experience with a few of the following models: Logistic Regression, Collaborative Filtering, SVM, K-armed bandits, Markov Models, Random Forests, Game Theory.
  • Dynamic, agile, and comfortable with the whole data stack. Capable of adjusting quickly to changing requirements and can deliver rapid and correct solutions.
  • Able to communicate the results of analyses clearly and effectively.
We are looking for a passionate person about technology and always strives to grow.
  • Able to ownership the work and always drives it towards the goal
  • Motivates and inspires people around as well as stays motivated himself
  • Always able to find solutions that are simple and correct architecture-wise
  • Customer/business-driven mindset

Full-stack developer team leader

We’re looking for a team lead to oversee and lead the full-stack developers. Our ideal candidate is passionate about technology, has good interpersonal skills, can think outside the box, and adjust to the situation. If you’re a hands-on, kind of leader with a can-do attitude, this opportunity is exactly what you are looking for.

About the role

We’re looking for a senior, hands-on full-stack developer who enjoys the behind-the-scenes world of back-end development for the front-end user experience.

You will be responsible for
  • Designing and developing various solutions for our data collection and analysis needs.
  • Help the Data Science team get the data they need and the data they deserve.
  • Implement decision-making processes in collaboration with the Data Science team.
Requirements
  • B.S in Computer Science, Information Systems Engineering, or equivalent degrees.
  • At least 6+ years of development work experience in an international company.
  • At least 2 years working as a team lead
  • Experience with Angular/React and node.js.
  • Be able to write in client- and server-side JS, Python, Scala/Akka, and use ElasticSearch and Redis.
  • Experience with control over data manipulation/investigation (in other words – SQL).
  • NoSQL environments, Adwords and Facebook REST APIs, Linux, GCE, AWS, Azure – big advantage.

Customer success manager

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to oversee and address our customers’ needs. You will provide ongoing support before and after the point of sale, ensuring customer satisfaction. As the customer success manager, you should be a tech-savvy professional, able to explain technical details and requirements to a non-technical audience. You should also be results-driven and aspire to achieve goals.

You will be responsible for
  • Provide support for customers on pre-sales and post-sales processes.
    Employ project management skills to drive all aspects of project planning for onboarding customers. 
  • Partner with data science, developers, and product teams to produce business value and coordinate tasks.
  • Always strive to provide an exceptional customer experience.
    Analyze customers’ needs and suggest up-sale and additional features the meet their requirements.
  • Assist customers’ technical requests and take care of any technical issues.
Build strong customer relationships, especially with key customer stakeholders and sponsors.

Requirements

  • Excellent verbal and written English and Hebrew communication skills – MUST
  • 2+ years of experience in either client-facing technical project management role or consulting technical implementations experience.
  • Experience in B2B/ SaaS/ eCommerce/ Digital Marketing industries– Advantage!
  • Analytical thinker and problem-solving skills.
  • An ability to gasp customers’ needs and suggest timely solutions.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, with well-developed interpersonal & communication skills and a strong desire to succeed.
